metadata.title: Florida County and Municipal Government Directory
metadata.scope: All 67 Florida counties and 411 current incorporated municipalities. Cross-county municipalities appear once and list every county. Unincorporated communities are served by county government.
metadata.verification: Names and county membership verified against the Florida Legislature EDR 2025 population workbook. Website domains sourced from official state directories or the municipality itself. Link availability varies and some official directories retain older domains; a link is a resource, not proof of jurisdiction or approval.

sources.name: Florida Legislature — Florida Population Estimates by County and Municipality, April 1, 2025
Florida Department of State — County Governments
Florida Department of State — Florida Cities
Florida League of Cities — Municipal Directory
